# Reusable project skills

These repository skills turn the EE4213 course methods and final-project requirements into repeatable workflows. Each skill lives in its own directory as a `SKILL.md` file and can be used independently or as a sequence.

| Skill | Use it when |
| --- | --- |
| [User research](user-research/SKILL.md) | Planning or conducting user research and synthesizing evidence |
| [Problem framing](problem-framing/SKILL.md) | Turning research into personas, problem statements, HMW questions, and a focused scope |
| [Interaction design](interaction-design/SKILL.md) | Designing and prototyping user workflows and interfaces |
| [Human-AI interaction](human-ai-interaction/SKILL.md) | Deciding whether and how AI belongs in a user-facing experience |
| [Usability validation](usability-validation/SKILL.md) | Planning usability studies and iterating from findings |
| [Agile planning](agile-planning/SKILL.md) | Creating a traceable backlog and planning short sprints |
| [EE4213 project delivery](ee4213-project-delivery/SKILL.md) | Checking work against the Fall 2026 group-project brief |

For a typical project, use research and problem framing first, then interaction design and (when relevant) HAI design. Validate the prototype, feed changes back into the design, and use agile planning to organize implementation. The EE4213 delivery skill is course-specific; do not apply its numeric requirements to other projects.
